backend_functions.name: spatial_query
calls:
session.execute(text('
        SELECT g.resource_id,g.version,ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geometry,15) AS geometry,v.spec
        FROM geographic_entities g JOIN resources r ON r.id=g.resource_id
        JOIN resource_versions v ON v.resource_id=g.resource_id AND v.version=g.version
        WHERE ' + conditions + ' ORDER BY g.resource_id,g.version LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset'), {'project': project_id, 'west': west, 'south': south, 'east': east, 'north': north, 'at': at, 'limit': limit + 1, 'offset': offset}).mappings

session.execute(text('
        SELECT g.resource_id,g.version,ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geometry,15) AS geometry,v.spec
        FROM geographic_entities g JOIN resources r ON r.id=g.resource_id
        JOIN resource_versions v ON v.resource_id=g.resource_id AND v.version=g.version
        WHERE ' + conditions + ' ORDER BY g.resource_id,g.version LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset'), {'project': project_id, 'west': west, 'south': south, 'east': east, 'north': north, 'at': at, 'limit': limit + 1, 'offset': offset}).mappings().all
